about: Centre Wellington is a township in Wellington County, Ontario, covering Fergus, Elora, and surrounding countryside rather than a single city. The Grand River cuts through limestone gorges at Elora and a mill-town main street at Fergus. Farms, villages, and river parks define the place more than continuous suburbia. About 31,000 people live in Centre Wellington.
seoSummary: Wellington County township of Fergus and Elora on the Grand River gorge—not a city.
